This is the cancelled onshore LNG EXPORT/liquefaction plant at Vasilikos (Noble Energy operator, Block 12) — distinct from the Cyprus FSRU import terminal. Re-sourced off-GEM with 2 independent non-GEM sources (no GEM self-publication cited): (1) the Cyprus Ministry of Energy hydrocarbons page (primary/regulatory) documents the onshore LNG Plant as 'currently on hold', citing unsuccessful Block 9 exploration wells and lower Aphrodite reserve estimates after the 2013 appraisal as having undermined viability (url_verifier PASS on 'on hold'); (2) 2B1st Consulting independently documents the same onshore liquefaction-export project — Noble Energy/Total, 5 mtpa per train, ~$6B Train 1 capex, FID once targeted for 2015/commercial ops 2019 — which never reached FID (url_verifier PASS on 'Noble Energy'; corroborates GEM's 5.0 mtpa and $6B capex). Page wording is 'on hold', so confidence stays yellow rather than green for the hard 'cancelled' label. Ref pairs the existing Status value (no value change). Note: the govt page gives NO specific shelving/cancellation years — the ShelvedYear(2017)/CancelledYear(2019)/StopYear(2019) values are RR's INFERRED values (Substatus 'inferred 4 y'; ShelvedCancelledStatusType 'inferred') and have no clean documenting source, so their [ref] columns are left BLANK rather than orphan-cited; see qa note.
